Exam Date & Time: 05-Aug-2022 (10:00 AM - 01:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. EXAMINATIONS (MIT MANIPAL) - AUGUST 2022  
  SUBJECT : CIE 1052 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  (MAKEUP)  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE 1052]  
Marks: 50                                                                         Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          Define the term "Tragedy of commons". Explain any four-evidence due to rise in the  
  Global CO2 levels.                                                                  (5)  
  
1B)             We use GDP as a metric for overall improvement in human life. Explain the same from  
  both economic and environmental perspective.                                               (5)  
  
2A)             With the help of a neat sketch explain an idealized soil profile with horizons.  
  (5)  
  
2B)             Draw the schematic representation for the following:  
  i) Structure of an ecosystem.                                                              (5)  
  ii) Holdridge life zone for terrestrial ecosystem.  
  
3A)             The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development adopted by the United Nations in 2015  
  commits to "ensure that all human beings can enjoy prosperous and fulfilling lives and  
  that economic, social and technological progress occurs in harmony with nature".           (5)  
  Explain.  
  
3B)             Explain some of the controlling measures of air pollutants in Industrial establishments.  
  (5)  
  
4A)             Explain the various sources of nuclear pollution with respect to both Natural and  
  Manmade sources.                                                                           (5)  
  
4B)             Enlist and explain the various Environmental legislations that have come into effect  
  related to water along with the penalties.                                                 (5)  
  
5A)             What are the applications of GIS in Disaster management? Draw the schematic  
  representation of the state level disaster management coordination mechanism.              (5)  
  
5B)             Explain with a case study the flooding and the water shortage crisis in Chennai during  
  the month of June.                                                                         (5)  
  
  
-----End-----
